releaseNotes:
CMF Buds Pro 2 Manager v2.3.3:
• Fixed false connection bug: smartwatches (Galaxy Watch, Amazfit, Mi Band, etc.) are strictly excluded and will never be mistaken for connected earbuds
• Strict Bluetooth detection: accurately checks physical A2DP/Headset/SPP status specifically for CMF Buds Pro 2 / Nothing Ear devices
• Full professional English localization by default + instant EN/RU language switcher in header and settings
• Hearing safety protection with gradual volume ramp-up for Find My Buds and Water Eject
